cases.name: missing-cli
cases.prompt: Delegate this read-only task.

cases.name: normal-dispatch
cases.prompt: Run one bounded task through the available agent provider.

cases.name: model-discovery-when-needed
cases.prompt: The caller needs an explicit model and effort for codex:exec.

cases.name: model-default-without-discovery
cases.prompt: Run a task without an explicit model or effort.

cases.name: timeout
cases.prompt: The result says status timed_out and continuation.resumable is true.

cases.name: continue-supervisor-migration
cases.prompt: An exact-session delegate continue command returned task_record not_created with failure.code supervisor_upgrade_required and failure.next_action run_supervisor_migrate. Migration then returned supervisor_control.state migrated and supervisor_control.next_action retry_dispatch.
expected: run same-root supervisor migrate exactly once
retry the argv-equivalent continue exactly once

cases.name: blocked-auth
cases.prompt: Capability output says live_acceptance.status is blocked.
expected: do not call a provider login command

cases.name: provider-neutrality
cases.prompt: Use the skill without a provider name.

cases.name: pi-write
cases.prompt: Use pi:json through delegate to update a file and run its tests. Edits are authorized.

cases.name: write-permission-denial
cases.prompt: An admitted workspace-write task reports a native tool permission denial.

cases.name: unavailable-provider
cases.prompt: The selected provider is unavailable before admission.
expected: do not install or authenticate provider

cases.name: write-timeout
cases.prompt: An authorized write task has status timed_out, publication unknown, no outcome, and continuation.resumable true.
expected: do not wait indefinitely for an outcome

cases.name: admitted-without-explicit-exit-marker
cases.prompt: Dispatch returned task_record created, admission admitted, and a task_id. The shell output did not include a separate EXIT marker. Confirm the task and collect its result.
expected: read saved dispatch response if needed
do not dispatch again to print an exit code
exactly one admitted task for the assignment

cases.name: ambient-root-ignored-across-shell-calls
cases.prompt: DELEGATE_ROOT is already set. Consult a separate external agent and answer its questions; each shell tool call starts a new shell.
expected: omit --root on dispatch, status, collect, reply, steer, and continue
ambient DELEGATE_ROOT has no root-selection authority
CLI resolves its default in the same user/configuration context
no assembled default, shell fallback, sample path, or per-task root

cases.name: ordinary-root-from-another-project
cases.prompt: DELEGATE_ROOT is unset. An admitted task was dispatched without --root in project A. Observe and continue it from project B in the same user/configuration context.
expected: omit --root on status, collect, and continue
CLI default is independent of project cwd
no path guessed from project A or B

cases.name: explicit-root-across-shell-calls
cases.prompt: For this isolated test, I explicitly choose the state root /state/custom with spaces. Consult a separate external agent and answer its questions; each shell tool call starts a new shell.
expected: pass --root with the exact single argument /state/custom with spaces on dispatch, status, collect, reply, steer, and continue
quote the root in shell commands
save and reassign absolute brief and response paths in each needed shell invocation
no ambient variable or fallback overrides the explicit choice

cases.name: historical-root-continuation
cases.prompt: An eligible predecessor task has recorded historical root /state/legacy with spaces. Continue that exact task and collect its successor. The current CLI default is different.
expected: pass the exact recorded --root argument /state/legacy with spaces on continue, status, and collect
use the exact predecessor and returned successor IDs
do not move or search for the task in the default root

cases.name: ordinary-schedule-root
cases.prompt: Create a recurring task in this project, then inspect its definition, history, and execution from another project in the same user/configuration context. No custom state root was requested.
expected: omit --root on schedule create, list, show, history, and execution
do not start a persistent scheduler inside the agent task
forward any returned scheduler.serve_command argv intact

cases.name: pending-without-questions
cases.prompt: The admitted task is running. Collect exits 3 with pending publication, empty pending_requests, and no operational error.
expected: no ps or pgrep or process-tree inspection
answer through delegate reply when a question appears

cases.name: interactive-worker-assignment
cases.prompt: Consult a separate external agent about a pricing plan and answer its questions from README.md.
expected: brief assigns the pricing investigation directly
worker does not recruit another external agent
do not copy the orchestration request verbatim

cases.name: interactive-clarification
cases.prompt: An external planning task returned pending.kind interaction with question IDs, choices, and free_text false. The requested preference is not in the user brief.
expected: reply through delegate with exact request and question IDs

cases.name: interactive-steering
cases.prompt: The user adds guidance while an interactive external task is running and its capabilities advertise steering.
expected: preserve task model permission and budget

cases.name: interactive-unknown-delivery
cases.prompt: A reply submission lost its CLI response. Its recorded delivery is unknown.
expected: same message ID and exact content to retrieve receipt

cases.name: interactive-unsupported-destination
cases.prompt: A named external provider supports continuation but neither native clarification nor steering. The user wants a discussion with it.
expected: do not pass unsupported interactive flag
